title: Order state machines and idempotency

objectives.text: Separate local submit/cancel intent,venue event/status and filled/open/closed-unexecuted quantities under a narrow explicit order transition model,including fills during pending cancel.

Use source/order/epoch-bound normalized event identity for exact duplicate no-op versus content conflict,and explain why local projection idempotency does not provide durable exactly-once external execution.

blocks.markdown: A command asks for an action; an event reports a source-confirmed occurrence; a status summarizes state after relevant events. Sending an order is not venue acceptance,acceptance is not a fill,and requesting cancellation is not cancellation confirmation. FIX ExecType(150)explains why an ExecutionReport was sent,while OrdStatus(39)describes reported state with precedence rules. Pending Cancel can take precedence over partial/filled states while the request is unresolved. A single status string without quantities/source identity can therefore mislead. Never zero possible exposure solely because a cancel request was sent.

Our code is deliberately narrower than FIX: ONE fixed-quantity order,ONE trusted normalized order/epoch namespace,quantity1..100 and<=32 input events. ACK moves submitted->working; REJECT is allowed only from submitted in this toy. FILL is allowed only after ACK while working,including while our local cancel flag is true. A full fill changes phase to filled. CANCEL_REQUEST sets a LOCAL pending flag while working; CANCEL_ACK while working/pending closes the unfilled remainder; CANCEL_REJECT clears the flag while working or filled. No replaces,fees/prices,unsolicited cancels,trade corrections/busts,multi-day rules or full FIX status precedence are implemented. Real FIX permits scenarios excluded here,including rejection after acknowledgement and some reduced-verbosity paths.

For this projection retain filled,remaining candidate quantity and unexecuted_closed. Required nonnegative accounting is quantity=filled+remaining+unexecuted_closed. Submitted quantity is conservatively a possible outstanding candidate,not proof of venue acceptance. On cancel/reject,remaining becomes0 but previously filled quantity stays filled; closed unexecuted remainder is tracked separately. These are OWN fields,not a universal mapping to FIX LeavesQty. Canceled quantity is not a reversal of confirmed fills or an account cash refund.

blocks.title: A fill can cross a cancel request

steps.text: Order10 is ACKed; FILL3 leaves filled3,remaining7. Send local CANCEL_REQUEST: flag true,but remaining7 is still possible execution.
FILL2 arrives before cancel confirmation: filled5,remaining5,flag still true. CANCEL_ACK then closes the5 unfilled units: phase canceled,filled5,remaining0,unexecuted_closed5.

Alternative: after cancel request,FILL10 completes the entire order. The cancel can then be rejected as too late; phase remains filled and the local request flag clears. The model does not pretend the request prevented the fill.

blocks.caption: Expected first tuple: ('canceled', 5, 0, 5, False, (1,2,3,4,5)) with Python spacing; second line True; third ('filled',10,0,0,False,(1,2,3,4)); last conflicting event identity. Pure full-batch projection returns only after all validation/transitions succeed; on ValueError no candidate result is published and caller inputs are unchanged. It records accepted normalized event IDs only within this one supplied history,not a durable ID store or real command/execution ID assignment.

blocks.markdown: Each normalized event is(event_id,kind,amount); exact ID+tuple duplicate is a no-op,even if repeated after a terminal state. Same ID with different tuple raises conflict before any candidate can be returned. A fresh event ID is not a license for an otherwise invalid transition,and a mathematically identical FILL under a fresh ID would count again if permitted by remaining quantity. Actual identity must bind source/session/order/execution namespace,not a guessed timestamp or payload amount. This toy has one namespace by construction; a real multi-order engine needs those explicit keys and a declared retention policy. Do not deduplicate equal-size legitimate fills merely because their values match.

Idempotent local projection means replaying identical normalized history/duplicates gives the same local result. It does NOT mean a sent external order executes exactly once. A timeout after send may leave an unknown outcome; blind resend can create a second order unless the venue's client-ID/session rules and reconciliation establish what happened. Persisting accepted identity and applying a local transition together needs a transactional/concurrency/recovery protocol. This pure full-batch function has none of those external effects or durable guarantees. If a fresh invalid event fails,retain the prior valid history and investigate; do not silently advance sequence/mark it applied.

Review each transition guard and the quantity invariant after every valid prefix. Include duplicate fill no-op,conflicting ID,overfill,fill before ACK,fill after canceled/rejected,duplicate terminal event,fill during pending cancel,full fill then cancel reject and rejection with zero fills. A rejected transition returns no new candidate for that batch; no caller-owned list/dict is mutated. These tests verify the explicit toy model,not every legal real FIX/venue sequence. A production engine must represent additional source events/status precedence and reconcile open orders/executions before assigning current exposure.

Independent transfer: build a reference transition table and enumerate bounded event streams,checking quantity decomposition,phase/flag consistency and duplicate invariance. Use unique source-bound fill IDs and prove two distinct equal-size fills remain two events. Extend only after writing new scenarios: partial cancel/replace,execution correction and reconnect unknown outcome require changed semantics/tests,not a silent else branch accepting anything. Keep the reducer separate from any live-send adapter.

Sources: [FIX EP284 Order State Changes November2023](https://www.fixtrading.org/wp-content/uploads/download-manager-files/FIX-Latest-as-of-EP284-Order-State-Changes.pdf), [versioned FIX order-state package](https://fixtrading.org/packages/fix-latest-specification-order-state-changes/), [FIX Session Layer June2020 duplicate/resend identities](https://www.fixtrading.org/wp-content/uploads/download-manager-files/FIX_Session_Layer_June_2020.pdf), and [event-sourcing concurrency/idempotency tradeoffs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/patterns/event-sourcing). The authored normalized model has its own smaller state graph/local flag,not the full FIX OrdStatus state machine or a live execution certification.

summary: Intent,source events and reported order status differ. Pending cancel does not remove fill exposure; preserve quantity accounting and source-bound event identity. Exact local duplicate no-op is not durable exactly-once execution,full FIX compatibility or account reconciliation.
